'''Saku Shrine''' (佐久神社) is a Japanese shrine. Several shrines with the same name are located primarily in Shizuoka Prefecture and Yamanashi Prefecture.

* [[Saku Shrine (Kofu)]] - A shrine located in Kofu City, Yamanashi Prefecture. Relocated by the feudal lord Kōzan Izumo no Kami in the 13th year of Tenbun (1543).
* [[Saku Shrine (Fuefuki)]] - A shrine located in Fuefuki City, Yamanashi Prefecture.
* [[Saku Shrine (Shizuoka)]] - A shrine located in Shimizu Ward, Shizuoka City, Shizuoka Prefecture.
== See Also ==
* [[Sakunado Shrine]] - A shrine located in Ōtsu City, Shiga Prefecture.
* [[Ihasaku Shrine]] - A shrine located in Toyama City, Toyama Prefecture.
